title: 11 Up
tagline: Pairs that make 11. Clear the table.
blurb: Open cards on a 4×4 grid. Pull two that sum to 11, or two of a face. Next card costs. Clear the table for a bonus.

copy.playing: Tap two open cards that make 11 — or two of the same face.
copy.next: New card on the table. Pass penalty.
copy.done: Sitting over. Deal again for a fresh grid.
copy.full: No empty cell. Take score or peel a pair.
